maddeler.e:
يستشهدن (form X)
# يَسْتَشْهِدْنَ (yastašhidna) /jas.taʃ.hid.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# يُسْتَشْهَدْنَ (yustašhadna) /jus.taʃ.had.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
